task_prompt:

Draft a brief, practical text to Mom (Margaret Chen) confirming these four items are handled: Metro Public Library due dates, UtilityCo monthly bill, anniversary gift, and dinner groceries. Keep the message concise and actionable.
answer: Hi Mom—quick update: the Metro Public Library due dates, UtilityCo’s monthly bill, your anniversary gift, and the dinner groceries are all handled. I’ll let you know if anything changes.
